# Little Kiwi Gone Curling

> > A New Zealander's blog documenting their overseas experience in Sweden, focusing on the technical art of curling ice maintenance at Sundbyberg Curlingklub.

This blog chronicles a Kiwi curler's journey learning ice maintenance techniques in Sweden through 'The Ice Apprentice' series. The content provides detailed insights into pebbling, hot mopping, scraping, and nipping—essential skills for maintaining championship-quality curling ice.

## The Ice Apprentice Series

- [The Ice Apprentice – The Art of Pebbling](https://littlekiwigonecurling.wordpress.com/2020/01/24/the-ice-apprentice-the-art-of-pebbling): Guide to pebble heads and pebbling technique at Sundbyberg Curlingklub
- [The Ice Apprentice – Tricky Nipping](https://littlekiwigonecurling.wordpress.com/2020/03/10/the-ice-apprentice-tricky-nipping): Nipping technique for pre-game ice preparation and pebble cutting
- [The Ice Apprentice: Scraping back the layers](https://littlekiwigonecurling.wordpress.com/2019/11/17/the-ice-apprentice-scraping-back-the-layers): Ice Boss machine scraping process and pebble removal at Sundbyberg
- [The Ice Apprentice – Hot Mopping like Cinderella](https://littlekiwigonecurling.wordpress.com/2019/11/01/the-ice-apprentice-hot-mopping-like-cinderella): Hot mopping and ice maintenance techniques at Sundbyberg rink
